sources.label: In-Context Learning for Robots: Methods and Applications
sources.scope: All 412 numbered references are reconciled. The author assigns 260 entries to four method families. This atlas follows manipulation methods; navigation, generic learning foundations and data-only resources retain explicit dispositions. A citation match is discovery provenance, not quantitative evidence for a method.
